title: Pocketwire Business Profile Rolling Reserve Ceilings and Periods
content:
A rolling reserve on a Pocketwire Business Profile holds back a percentage of each sale. Per tier, the schedule fixes the highest percentage the risk team can assign, how long each holdback is kept from the sale date, and how many calendar days after the reserve was set the seller may ask for it to be reduced. Column headings abbreviate the six tiers of the Pocketwire Business Profile: Pocketwire Business Starter, Pocketwire Business Essentials, Pocketwire Business Growth, Pocketwire Business Pro, Pocketwire Business Premier and Pocketwire Business Enterprise.

| | Starter | Essentials | Growth | Pro | Premier | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Highest rolling reserve percentage the risk team can assign (of each sale) | 30% | 25% | 20% | 15% | 10% | 10% |
| Each holdback kept for (calendar days from the sale date) | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 60 | 60 |
| Reduction may be asked for after (calendar days since the reserve was set) | 90 | 90 | 90 | 60 | 60 | 30 |

**Worked figure (hypothetical reserve).** On Pocketwire Business Pro, a reserve of 12% is within the 15% ceiling. A sale of USD 250.00 then books a holdback of USD 30.00, kept for 90 calendar days from the sale date. A reserve of 18% could not be assigned on that tier.
